title: Copies that keep the rules

howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, Night glass: a dark hall of frosted panes, frosted where what's behind may not be read and clear where it may, with cards of frosted glass and bright rims. Cyan is an identity, green allowed, coral denied or closed, violet hidden personal data, and gold the chip of a column's class.
